description: Election Commission - Mr. Umer Ali Ranees Selected as a Member of Kinniya Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kinniya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned member, including the nomination procedure by a political party and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under electoral processes and related administrative matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
